title: The next life
translation: Someone who keeps the next life in mind and knows a thing or two about the Buddha's teaching: that's someone I'd like to know better.
original: {後|のち}の{世|よ}のこと{心|こころ}に{忘|わす}れず、{仏|ほとけ}の{道|みち}うとからぬ、{心|こころ}にくし。
literal: Not forgetting in one's heart the matter of the next world, not being distant from the way of the Buddha: admirable.

notes.text: 'The later world': the next life, after death and rebirth.
うとし: 'distant, unfamiliar'. Modern {疎|うと}い means 'ignorant of, out of touch with'.
{心|こころ}にくし: 'admirable', with a sense that the person makes you curious and you would like to know more. Compare section 150. The whole section is one sentence and one judgement.
